title: Saada nägijaks / Made Seeing
license: no licence notice; ETV/ERR archive, all rights reserved implied
notes: Estonian, almost wordless: four Sven Grünberg electronic compositions realised as television — synthesizer and hand drums in Kaarel Kurismaa's designed room of kinetic objects, a man singing inside a circle of light, a green scan-line moiré, a frame drum against a painted mandala. Fetched by yt-dlp ERRArhiiv HLS; cut from local-dev/broadcast-src/_crop/ (ERR corner bug cropped off the top, non-square SAR 3:4 normalised to square-pixel 4:3). All-music item: every window 10 s, no long window (my brief allows one only on a non-musical stretch)
